data_scope.recording_unit: recordings, not people; speaker IDs unknown; no speaker-disjoint claim
data_scope.ocr_fonts: Sans and Serif both seen in training; historical condition unseen_font labels do not imply an unseen font
data_scope.ocr_region_source: one caller-provided contiguous 1–4-cell ROI; no text detection model

v2.manifest_scope: From-random finite Chinese chat/history/format, Fashion-MNIST3 and public two-slot relations, twelve traditional glyph OCR <=4chars with suppliedROI, three MInDS14zhCN intents with actual voice-to-text continuation, and genuine bounded calculator. No pretrained neural components, runtime ASR or answer lookup. All original heldout records/media unchanged; V2 training uses both Sans/Serif fonts.

products.scope: Finite fixed grammar; C includes disclosed identical generic observations across family splits. Heldout-family scores are not open-domain natural-language generalization. More loops may worsen accuracy/CE. Latency is CPU/device-specific; concentration is not probability of correctness.

duplicate_example.method: Read all rows of data-v2/c.jsonl, compare exact state, collect (split,gold) by question; no model inference.
duplicate_example.scope: Concrete identical state/question/candidate semantics/label across isolated world families. This is one actual example, not a new leakage-count audit or unseen-language proof.

auto_policy.selected_on: policy only; maximum end-to-end accuracy subject mean actual B loops over all complete eligible<=3; ties lower mean loops then lexical rule

policy_quality.denominator_scope: Every predeclared truly supported complete B input, including C rejections as failures. C cost is additional; loop counts are not end-to-end time.
